info.description: Public control-plane API v1. Every read returns an owner-supplied ReadResult. Commands return a durable Operation, a CommandRejection when they were not admitted, or a typed admission/forwarding failure when existence cannot safely be inferred; they do not synthesize state from another owner.

json-schema/v1/archive-artifact-detail.s.description: Archive Export-owned artifact identity, Recorder attribution, upload attempts, and independent indexing receipts.
json-schema/v1/archive-artifact-detail.s.title: ArchiveArtifactDetail

json-schema/v1/archive-export-provider.s.description: The Archive Export owner's non-secret configured provider reference. It is a configuration fact only; it does not report Recorder finalization, .vital formation, upload, indexing, or provider reachability.
json-schema/v1/archive-export-provider.s.title: ArchiveExportProviderConfiguration

json-schema/v1/artifact-export-command.s.description: A request to finalize a stopped Lab virtual recorder source and export its immutable artifact. It is separate from Lab stop.

source.description: The finalized Recorder Gateway source receipt that Archive Export must verify and form. A stopped virtual recorder alone is not archive source evidence.

json-schema/v1/artifact-export-command.s.title: ArtifactExportCommand

json-schema/v1/artifact-manifest.schema..description: An immutable artifact identity created only after source finalization succeeds.
json-schema/v1/artifact-manifest.schema..title: ArtifactManifest

json-schema/v1/capability-document.schem.description: A Guest Runtime-preserved provider capability observation. Unsupported is explicit, not an omitted field.
json-schema/v1/capability-document.schem.title: CapabilityDocument

json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-admis.description: The Recorder Observation Catalog owner's durable admission receipt. Duplicate and quarantined are explicit persisted outcomes; an unknown write outcome is a CommandAdmissionFailure, not this receipt.
json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-admis.title: CatalogObservationAdmission

json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-comma.description: A request to persist an immutable Recorder self-observation projection. Catalog assigns receivedAt/persistedAt and preserves device occurredAt unchanged.
json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-comma.title: CatalogObservationIngestCommand

json-schema/v1/catalog-observation.schem.description: An immutable Guest Runtime Observation Catalog projection of a Recorder-owned self-observation. Catalog timestamps do not replace the device occurredAt fact.
json-schema/v1/catalog-observation.schem.title: CatalogObservation

json-schema/v1/clock-quality.schema.json.description: A Time Authority-owned clock quality observation. A timestamp alone is not evidence of synchronization.
json-schema/v1/clock-quality.schema.json.title: ClockQuality

json-schema/v1/command-admission-failure.description: A typed failure while admitting a command. admissionState=not-admitted proves no Operation was persisted; admissionState=unknown preserves that the caller must retry the exact requestId after the owner recovers.
json-schema/v1/command-admission-failure.title: CommandAdmissionFailure

json-schema/v1/command-rejection.schema..description: A typed command non-admission result. No Operation exists for this result. It can describe invalid input, revision conflict, or a dependency failure determined before forwarding.
json-schema/v1/command-rejection.schema..title: CommandRejection

json-schema/v1/common.schema.json.title: Runtime Platform v1 common contract definitions

json-schema/v1/deletion-receipt.schema.j.description: A Lab-owned immutable receipt that distinguishes resources deleted from Archive-owned artifacts deliberately retained by policy.
json-schema/v1/deletion-receipt.schema.j.title: DeletionReceipt

json-schema/v1/delivery-receipt.schema.j.description: One Recorder Gateway-owned upstream delivery attempt. It is separate from ingress durability and preserves an uncertain upstream outcome instead of claiming delivery success.
json-schema/v1/delivery-receipt.schema.j.title: DeliveryReceipt

json-schema/v1/export-receipt.schema.jso.description: An Archive Export-owned receipt. Upload and indexing success remain separate facts.
json-schema/v1/export-receipt.schema.jso.title: ExportReceipt

json-schema/v1/external-upstream-command.description: A revisioned command to persist and explicitly observe an ExternalUpstreamIntegration. The command carries only references, never endpoint secrets.
json-schema/v1/external-upstream-command.title: ExternalUpstreamApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/external-upstream-integra.description: A Guest Runtime-owned configuration and explicit provider observation for an external VitalServer upstream. It contains references, never endpoint secrets or provider-private state.
json-schema/v1/external-upstream-integra.title: ExternalUpstreamIntegration

VitalServerArchiveProvider.description: The distinct capability that uploads and verifies indexed .vital files. The C37 Archive Export provider must match this reference exactly; it is not inferred from Socket.IO delivery.

VitalServerObservationEndpoint.description: The exact unauthenticated-or-credential-free HTTP endpoint the external VitalServer administrator authorizes this product to probe. Redirects, an inferred health path, and a success range are deliberately not implied.

json-schema/v1/external-vitalserver-deli.description: C46 Guest Product deployment-administrator configuration for one C44-selected external VitalServer target. It binds a declared external integration to explicit Socket.IO packet delivery, operator-declared HTTP observation, and indexed-library archive endpoints. It names an archive credential reference but never contains credential material. It is desired configuration, not a connection, authentication, packet-delivery, archive-export, index, or VitalServer clinical-state observation.
json-schema/v1/external-vitalserver-deli.title: ExternalVitalServerDeliveryConfiguration

json-schema/v1/facade-forwarding-failure.description: A Host facade failure while forwarding a command to its configured Guest endpoint. It never claims that a Guest operation does or does not exist when deliveryDisposition is unknown.
json-schema/v1/facade-forwarding-failure.title: FacadeForwardingFailure

json-schema/v1/guest-archive-credential-.description: Non-secret C51 availability projection returned only through the OS-authorized Host Agent local-administration facade. It identifies the C46 credential reference but never includes C51 userId, password, material bytes, digest, path, or filesystem detail.
json-schema/v1/guest-archive-credential-.title: GuestArchiveCredentialMaterialAvailability

json-schema/v1/guest-archive-credential-.description: Immediate non-secret result of accepting one C51 document through the OS-authorized Host Agent local-administration facade. It is not a durable operation or receipt and contains no C51 userId, password, bytes, digest, or path.
json-schema/v1/guest-archive-credential-.title: GuestArchiveCredentialMaterialProvisioningOutcome

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C35 complete, immutable Release-build input for GuestArtifactCompiler. Every source is addressed below the explicit input root and identified by byte size and SHA-256. The selected builder copies the declared bootable Guest root-storage base and derives one read-only RAW bootstrap storage image containing the Guest-visible NoCloud ISO9660 volume from C37/C38/C39/C44, C46 for an external topology, or the C64 manager executable and configuration for a bundled topology. arm64 additionally names the macOS Virtualization boot artifacts. amd64 intentionally has no Host kernel/initial-ramdisk output because native UEFI firmware boots the declared disk directly. The builder must not discover a Linux base, root partition, source directory, filesystem editor, storage role, topology, or delivery target.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationCommand

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C41 release-build source selection for atomically assembling one complete Guest Product C35 input root. sourceAbsolutePath is Host build-machine input only and must never appear in emitted C35/C34/C65/C35 receipt. The declaration selects one Guest Product bootstrap artifact composer, one copied raw bootable root-storage base, C44 topology deployment, either the C46 external delivery configuration or the paired C64 manager payload, and one generated read-only NoCloud bootstrap volume without implicit builder, source, topology, delivery target, or storage-role choice. arm64 additionally selects macOS Virtualization boot resources; amd64 deliberately omits them because the selected native UEFI provider boots the disk directly.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyDeclaration

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C41 immutable evidence that one GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyDeclaration produced one complete C35 input root. It proves assembled source identity and C35 command identity, not Guest image compilation, boot, systemd startup, or package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyReceipt

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C35 successful GuestArtifactCompiler result. It records the exact builder executable, declared input identities, architecture, and the emitted C34 arm64/macOS or C65 amd64/native manifest identity. It proves compilation input/output correlation only; Guest boot and clean-Host installation require separate evidence.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationReceipt

ImageSetManagerEndpoint.description: The C32 Host-loopback-to-C64 AF_VSOCK endpoint. It is local-only and has no guest-IP or public-network fallback.

json-schema/v1/guest-bundled-upstream-im.description: C66 immutable release-owned desired input for one C26 bundled-Upstream image-set effect executor. It fixes the Host-loopback C32-to-C64 bridge and the apply/rollback active-image-set compare-and-swap commands. The Host updater verifies the configuration artifact bytes but does not decode it.
json-schema/v1/guest-bundled-upstream-im.title: GuestBundledUpstreamImageSetEffectExecutorConfiguration

ActiveImageSetSelection.description: The selected active image-set is explicitly either unprovisioned or active. A missing/invalid/unreadable manager state document is not represented by this desired or observed selection.

containerEngine.description: The one Guest-owned engine command. C64 invokes only its fixed `load --input` and `compose --project-name --file up --detach --remove-orphans` forms.

json-schema/v1/guest-bundled-upstream-im.description: C64 Guest-owned bundled Upstream container image-set configuration, update command, and durable operation. A Host C55 executor may submit an immutable image-set archive through the declared C32 bridge but never reads or writes Guest image-set state and never invokes the Guest container engine.
json-schema/v1/guest-bundled-upstream-im.title: GuestBundledUpstreamImageSetManagement

json-schema/v1/guest-installed-runtime-e.description: Release-runner evidence that an installed Guest exposed an available C77 identity through the Host facade before or after an observed Host reboot, and that a direct Recorder multipart upload was attributed to the explicit Recorder by the Archive owner. It does not infer Guest state from package, process, file, or log presence.
json-schema/v1/guest-installed-runtime-e.title: GuestInstalledRuntimeEvidence

json-schema/v1/guest-lifecycle-command.s.description: A Host Agent command for an explicitly addressed Guest provider. Revision mismatch is rejected before an operation exists.
json-schema/v1/guest-lifecycle-command.s.title: GuestLifecycleCommand

json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.description: C42 immutable release-build declaration for publishing one ARM64 Linux root filesystem, uncompressed kernel Image, and initial ramdisk as distinct identified release-build inputs. A boot resource is read either from the explicitly selected ext4 source filesystem or from its own identified external source artifact; it is never guessed from the root image. The source filesystem is either the entire raw disk or one explicitly numbered raw-disk partition. A QCOW2 source disk must first be materialized through C73. Build-machine paths never appear in the receipt or emitted artifacts.
json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.title: GuestLinuxBootArtifactExtractionDeclaration

json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.description: C42 immutable evidence that a byte-identified ARM64 whole-disk ext4 image produced one uncompressed Linux Image for the macOS Virtualization boot loader, one initial ramdisk, and one root-storage artifact. It proves neither a C35 compilation, Guest boot, systemd startup, nor package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.title: GuestLinuxBootArtifactExtractionReceipt

json-schema/v1/guest-linux-source-disk-m.description: C73 release-build declaration and receipt for converting one identified ARM64 QCOW2 Guest Linux source image into one immutable raw disk image. It does not select or download a source image, inspect Guest boot files, create C42/C43 outputs, or claim Guest boot or package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-linux-source-disk-m.title: GuestLinuxSourceDiskMaterialization

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-a.description: Immutable Archive-owner metadata inventory included in C76. It does not claim that raw artifact object bytes were copied or retained.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-a.title: GuestOperationalStateArtifactInventory

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.description: Requests one Guest-owned operational-state snapshot into an explicitly selected immutable destination. It does not select retention or claim publication success.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.title: GuestOperationalStateBackupCommand

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.description: Immutable successful C76 backup evidence. Artifact metadata is inventoried; raw artifact object bytes are deliberately outside v1.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.title: GuestOperationalStateBackupManifest

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.description: Durable C76 backup or empty-target restore workflow state. Stage evidence is explicit and terminal failure remains readable.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-b.title: GuestOperationalStateBackupOperation

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-e.description: Owner-provided proof that one explicitly selected restore target has no SQLite state and no PostgreSQL owner state. A missing or failed probe is not an empty target.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-e.title: GuestOperationalStateEmptyTargetProof

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-i.description: One atomic Guest-owner observation of the SQLite control ledger, PostgreSQL accumulated state, persisted migration receipt, and non-secret aggregate private-material identity used by installation, reboot, and restore acceptance. A partial or inferred identity is not valid.

bootstrap.description: Persisted owner evidence from the explicit C37 paths. It exposes no material value or individual material digest.

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-i.title: GuestOperationalStateIdentity

json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-r.description: Requests restore of one immutable C76 manifest into one explicitly provisioned target. The restore workflow must independently prove that target empty.
json-schema/v1/guest-operational-state-r.title: GuestOperationalStateRestoreCommand

GuestArchiveArtifactObjectDirectory.description: Persistent Archive Export-owned object root prepared before direct upload admission.

GuestPrivateStateDirectory.description: Persistent Guest-owned private material root. It is deliberately not /run, so reboot cannot erase database credentials or internal bearer tokens.

GuestProductRelease.description: One immutable Guest Product code/configuration directory and the Guest Product Release Manager-owned active link. C40 creates the link only when it is absent or already points to this declared release; it never retargets a previously activated release during bootstrap.

GuestProductReleaseManager.description: C59 Guest Product Release Manager payload and its separately supervised systemd unit. It remains available while it restarts the distinct Guest Product service through the current-release link.

GuestRuntimeStateDirectory.description: The Guest Runtime-owned mutable state root which C40 provisions before the C38 supervisor may start the stateful Guest Runtime. C40 must verify this directory is the parent of C37 guestRuntime.stateDatabasePath.

GuestTelemetryStateDirectory.description: The Guest telemetry Collector-owned mutable storage root that C40 provisions before C38 starts C37. The Collector reports later write failures explicitly; this desired directory is not a readiness observation.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-bootstrap-c.description: C39 desired first-Guest-boot installation for the Guest Product. It declares one immutable Guest Product release directory, its explicitly activated current-release link, one explicit Linux Guest architecture, Guest-owned payload destinations, independently owned Guest Runtime and telemetry Collector state directories, an optional explicit Guest NTP service installation, and the Guest-visible NoCloud filesystem identity only; it never names a Host-selected root partition, Host storage-image container, ext4 implementation, or Host-side filesystem write. The Guest Node Services bundle contains the declared Node runtime, Recorder Gateway, Lab Recorder Runner, and scenario catalog; its archive entry-mode and symbolic-link policies are independent declarations so a consumer can distinguish permission preservation from safe link acceptance.

externalVitalServerDeliveryConfiguration.description: Optional C46 payload. C44 external-vitalserver selection makes it required during cross-document bootstrap composition; bundled topology must not install it as an unused fallback.

guestBundledUpstreamImageSetManager.description: Optional C64 first-Guest-boot payload. It exists only for a C44 bundled-vitalserver topology. C40 installs its executable, immutable configuration and systemd unit, creates the separately owned C64 state root, and explicitly initializes the active-image-set selection once before starting the service. VitalServerArchiveProviderConfiguration.description: The explicit desired document read by Guest Runtime's indexed-library adapter. C46 is an externally-administered target; C44 is the release-owned bundled target. The kind is never inferred from a loopback address.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-process-dep.description: C37 Guest-owned desired deployment input for the required Guest Runtime, Recorder Gateway, Lab recorder Runner, and optionally selected Guest telemetry Collector process. GuestProductReleaseManagerEndpoint.description: The C32 Host-loopback-to-C59 AF_VSOCK endpoint. It is local-only and has no guest-IP or public-network fallback.

ControlVirtioSocketListener.description: Guest-side C59 AF_VSOCK listener. C32 owns the corresponding Host-loopback bridge; this document deliberately contains no Host address.

GuestProductReleaseUpdateCommand.description: The metadata JSON part of one multipart release-upload request. The archive part named releaseArchive must exactly match targetRelease.artifact; an absent, truncated, or mismatched archive is not a command admission.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-release-man.description: C59 Guest Product Release Manager desired deployment, one release-update command carried with its declared archive bytes, and the manager-owned durable operation record. The manager is the only Guest component allowed to stage a release below the configured immutable release root or atomically retarget the current-release link. It preserves separately owned runtime, ingress, archive, and telemetry data directories; Host code never mounts or edits Guest state to implement this operation.

GuestProductSupervisorLogging.description: The declared Guest-owned evidence sinks for the process supervisor. journal+console keeps systemd history and C32 serial-console capture aligned without allowing a missing sink to be treated as silent success.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-service-man.description: C38 Guest-owned desired service-manager input for starting and supervising one GuestProductProcessSupervisor. It names the Linux service-manager unit, the supervisor executable and C37 configuration paths, explicit restart behavior, and the required diagnostic log sinks. It is not evidence that systemd installed, enabled, started, restarted, or stopped the unit, nor that the Guest Runtime or Recorder Gateway is ready.

BundledUpstreamImageSetDeployment.description: Required desired facts for a C64-owned VitalServer/Redis image set. ExternalVitalServerDeploymentConfigurati.description: References, never endpoint or credential material. The selected external provider configuration resolves delivery material before Gateway activation.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-vitalserver.description: C44 Guest Product release-author desired topology for Recorder Gateway VitalServer packet delivery and optional browser exposure. It selects bundled or external placement and preserves every required artifact or integration reference. It is not a connection, process, packet-delivery, or clinical-state observation.

json-schema/v1/recorder-observability-su.description: The Catalog-owned current projection. Support, expectation, report freshness, and owner read state remain independent facts.
json-schema/v1/recorder-observability-su.title: RecorderObservabilitySummary

json-schema/v1/recorder-observation-enve.description: A Vital Recorder-owned self-observation. Gateway and Catalog may add received or persisted timestamps but must not overwrite occurredAt.
json-schema/v1/recorder-observation-enve.title: RecorderObservationEnvelope

json-schema/v1/recorder-reported-inciden.description: A typed issue explicitly reported by the Recorder. Packet gaps, logs, missing reports, and UI refresh failures do not create this resource.
json-schema/v1/recorder-reported-inciden.title: RecorderReportedIncident

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-plan.sch.description: A release-process-owned declaration of one intended installer artifact, platform-specific installer identity, its required Host service registrations, and every proof required before it may be called releasable. It is a plan, not evidence that an artifact exists or installed successfully.

macOSInstallerPackageIdentifier.description: The macOS pkgbuild package identifier that a macOS release installer must realize. It is release identity, not a Host Agent installation identifier.

macOSInstallerSignaturePolicy.description: The release-process-owned macOS Installer signature state that C23 requires C24 to observe. unsigned permits a deliberately unsigned PKG only when pkgutil explicitly reports Status: no signature; developer-id requires an accepted Apple Developer ID Installer signature. Neither policy is inferred from a build host or installer exit code.

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-plan.sch.title: ReleaseDeliveryPlan

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof-at.description: Release-process-owned review record for a new immutable C24 proof set. It records the exact source proof set, proof fragments, and evidence identities that an operator explicitly reviewed. It neither creates Host state nor changes a canonical source proof set in place.
json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof-at.title: ReleaseDeliveryProofAttachmentReview

ObservedInstallerArtifact.description: A clean-host runner observation of the exact installer artifact used for this proof stage. It is an observed identity, not C23 desired release input.

ObservedMacOSInstallerReceipt.description: A clean macOS Host observation that the C23-owned PKG receipt is installed after the explicit installer effect.

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof.sc.description: Release-process-owned proof records for declared delivery plans. A pending, unsupported, or failed stage never represents installation success. Every verified stage records the observed installer artifact identity so it cannot prove a different release. A verified service-registration record must also name each observed required Host service registration explicitly.
json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof.sc.title: ReleaseDeliveryProofSet

json-schema/v1/runtime-console-desktop-a.description: C71 Runtime Console packager-owned immutable identity for one desktop installer artifact. It is a build result, not proof that the Console or Host product was installed.
json-schema/v1/runtime-console-desktop-a.title: RuntimeConsoleDesktopArtifactReceipt

json-schema/v1/runtime-topology-apply-co.description: A command accepted only when the explicit expected resource revision matches the owner state.
json-schema/v1/runtime-topology-apply-co.title: ApplyRuntimeTopologyCommand

json-schema/v1/runtime-topology.schema.j.description: A Guest Runtime-owned topology resource. Spec is requested configuration; status is explicit observed provider state.
json-schema/v1/runtime-topology.schema.j.title: RuntimeTopology

json-schema/v1/service-readiness.schema..description: A service-owned readiness observation. It is not synthesized from another service's process or logs.
json-schema/v1/service-readiness.schema..title: ServiceReadiness

json-schema/v1/staged-update-handoff.sch.description: C31 durable Host-local queue item. The deployment supervisor resolves invocationRelativePath under the Host-owned staging root, then passes the original C30 document to the staged next updater.
json-schema/v1/staged-update-handoff.sch.title: StagedUpdateHandoff

json-schema/v1/staged-update-invocation..description: C30 Host-to-next-updater local handoff document. The Host writes it only after C29 is durably handoff-pending, atomically stages the bundle, and records the exact request and handoff journal revision that the next updater must present with C27 completion. Host atomically verifies that handoff revision, marks execution applying, and settles C28. The next updater locates and validates opaque C26 itself; C26 is not embedded or decoded by the current Host updater.
json-schema/v1/staged-update-invocation..title: StagedUpdateInvocation

json-schema/v1/staged-update-layer-effec.description: C55 typed outcome written by one C26-declared layer effect executor. The staged next updater verifies correlation and aggregates these receipts into C28; a process exit, log, or missing receipt is not an outcome.
json-schema/v1/staged-update-layer-effec.title: StagedUpdateLayerEffectReceipt

json-schema/v1/telemetry-correlation.sch.description: A safe correlation envelope for OpenTelemetry logs, metrics, and traces. It is diagnostic evidence, not product state.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-correlation.sch.title: TelemetryCorrelation

json-schema/v1/telemetry-emission-receip.description: A diagnostic-only receipt for a redacted, bounded telemetry emission attempt. It contains key names and outcomes, never untrusted attribute values.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-emission-receip.title: TelemetryEmissionReceipt

json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline-comman.description: A revisioned request to apply a node-local OTLP telemetry pipeline declaration.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline-comman.title: TelemetryPipelineApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline.schema.description: A node-local OpenTelemetry/OTLP diagnostic pipeline. Its health is not product domain state or proof of another operation outcome.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline.schema.title: TelemetryPipeline

json-schema/v1/telemetry-signal-command..description: A diagnostic signal emission request. Attribute values are input to policy only and are never persisted in a TelemetryEmissionReceipt.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-signal-command..title: TelemetrySignalEmitCommand

json-schema/v1/time-authority-command.sc.description: A revisioned request to apply a node-local NTP profile and obtain an explicit ClockQuality observation.
json-schema/v1/time-authority-command.sc.title: TimeAuthorityApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/time-authority.schema.jso.description: A node-local Time Authority resource. Each Host or Guest owns only its own NTP profile and ClockQuality observation.
json-schema/v1/time-authority.schema.jso.title: TimeAuthority

json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-envelope.description: C25 immutable, signed bootstrap contract. The currently installed Host updater verifies and stages only this compact envelope and its next-updater artifact. It deliberately has no minimumUpdaterVersion field: every release carries a compatible bootstrap envelope and a signed next updater that parses the opaque product specification.
json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-envelope.title: UpdateBootstrapEnvelope

json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-receipt..description: C27 typed Host-native bootstrap verification and staging result. Staged is only a handoff precondition, never update success.
json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-receipt..title: UpdateBootstrapReceipt

json-schema/v1/update-completion-command.description: C27 Host-local command from the staged next updater. The expected journal revision prevents a superseded updater process from settling recovery state it no longer owns.
json-schema/v1/update-completion-command.title: UpdateCompletionCommand

json-schema/v1/update-execution-report.s.description: C28 next-updater-owned execution evidence. Host validates stable bootstrap correlation, declared order, and typed layer/rollback outcomes; it does not reinterpret the product specification.
json-schema/v1/update-execution-report.s.title: UpdateExecutionReport

json-schema/v1/vital-replay-corpus-manif.description: Release-process declaration of human-approved, non-identifying, redistribution-authorized Recorder .vital artifacts used for v1-v3 replay compatibility evidence. The declaration does not itself prove the selected bytes; the corpus verifier binds every entry to an exact regular file.
json-schema/v1/vital-replay-corpus-manif.title: VitalReplayCorpusManifest

json-schema/v1/vitalserver-indexed-libra.description: Guest-local secret-owner material consumed only by the VitalServer indexed-library Archive adapter. C46 contains the matching identity reference but never this document or its values. This document must not be emitted in package inputs, state, telemetry, API responses, examples, or receipts.
json-schema/v1/vitalserver-indexed-libra.title: VitalServerIndexedLibraryCredentialMaterial
